name: Shelah
bio: Shelah is Judah's third son. After his brothers Er and Onan both died, Judah should have given Shelah to Tamar as a husband, but fearing he might suffer the same fate as his brothers, he kept delaying the marriage, leaving Tamar waiting indefinitely as a widow in her father's house — a delay that directly drove Tamar's later scheme to disguise herself and force Judah to fulfill his obligation (Genesis 38:11, 14, 26).
